goal: Design the node: an STM32G474 drives a DC motor with a PWM signal, talks UART to an ESP32 and has to stay under a sleep-current budget. Decompose the work into steps, work out the clock and PLL configuration, check the logic-level compatibility between the STM32G474 and the ESP32 and check the sleep-current budget. Give the design as a numbered plan with the numbers.

rationale: Initial project plan to design the STM32G474 node with DC motor PWM, UART to ESP32, clock/PLL configuration, logic-level checks, and sleep-current budget.
